title: Super Bowl
description: The annual NFL championship game, one of the most watched sporting events in the United States.

title: Stanley Cup Finals
description: The NHL championship series, the oldest professional sports trophy in North America.

title: NBA Finals
description: The annual championship series of the National Basketball Association.

title: FIFA World Cup
description: The FIFA World Cup is the most prestigious association football tournament in the world.

title: Wimbledon
description: The oldest and most prestigious tennis tournament in the world, held at the All England Club in London.

title: Tour de France
description: Annual men's multiple-stage bicycle race primarily held in France.

title: The Masters (Golf)
description: One of golf's four major championships, held annually at Augusta National Golf Club.

title: UEFA Champions League Final
description: The annual final of Europe's premier club football competition.

title: Boston Marathon
description: The world's oldest annual marathon, held on Patriots' Day in April.

title: Academy Awards (Oscars)
description: The Academy Awards, or Oscars, are the most prestigious awards in the film industry.

title: Grammy Awards
description: The Grammy Awards are the premier annual music awards recognizing achievement in the music industry.

title: Cannes Film Festival
description: Annual international film festival held in Cannes, France, one of the world's most prestigious film festivals.

title: New Year's Eve
description: The last day of the Gregorian calendar year, celebrated worldwide with fireworks and festivities.

title: Christmas
description: An annual festival commemorating the birth of Jesus Christ, widely celebrated with gift-giving and family gatherings.

title: Halloween
description: Annual holiday celebrated on October 31st with costumes, candy, and spooky traditions.

title: Thanksgiving (US)
description: A national holiday in the United States celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November.

title: Summer Solstice
description: The longest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere, marking the start of astronomical summer.

title: Winter Solstice
description: The shortest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere, marking the start of astronomical winter.

title: Spring Equinox
description: The vernal equinox marks the beginning of spring in the Northern Hemisphere.

title: Autumn Equinox
description: The autumnal equinox marks the beginning of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere.

title: World Cup of Rugby
description: The Rugby World Cup is the international championship of men's rugby union.

title: Summer Olympics
description: The Summer Olympics are the world's foremost international multi-sport event, held every four years.

title: Winter Olympics
description: The Winter Olympics are held every four years, featuring winter sports such as skiing, skating, and snowboarding.

title: World Environment Day
description: The United Nations' principal vehicle for encouraging awareness and action for the protection of the environment.

title: International Women's Day
description: A global day celebrating the social, economic, cultural, and political achievements of women.

title: Earth Day
description: An annual event celebrated worldwide to demonstrate support for environmental protection.

title: Trooping the Colour
description: The annual military parade celebrating the official birthday of the British Sovereign.

title: Juneteenth
description: A federal holiday in the United States commemorating the emancipation of enslaved African Americans.

title: Bastille Day
description: The French national holiday commemorating the storming of the Bastille prison on July 14, 1789.

title: Guy Fawkes Night
description: Also known as Bonfire Night, this UK tradition commemorates the failed Gunpowder Plot of 1605.

title: Diwali
description: The Hindu festival of lights, one of the most popular and significant festivals in South Asian cultures.

title: Ramadan
description: The ninth month of the Islamic calendar, observed by Muslims worldwide as a month of fasting and prayer.

title: Hanukkah
description: The Jewish Festival of Lights, celebrated for eight nights and days.

title: Black Friday
description: The day after Thanksgiving in the US, traditionally the start of the holiday shopping season.

title: Cyber Monday
description: The Monday after Thanksgiving, known for online shopping deals.
